Delete the word "Souli" as spoken by Babu.

Reduce the fight between Paulad Singh and the gangsters in police dress, to less than one minute's duration, by deleting all gruesome shots of fight, and delete the crushing of men with jeep.
Delete the words "Moonh se bol raha hoon" as spoken by Chuiſa on phone.

In the picturisation of the song "inehGil bhi hum sajaya.......", delete the visuals glamouring drinking and the shots of Anita with exposed thigh and indecorous movement of hip when the camera zooms close to her hip. Heads banged on table and man crushing out of window.
Shots of shooting near about the feet.
Hard punch.

Delete the reference to "Sarkar" in the dialogue Sarkar agar inki zimendari lo lo .... as spoken by Raju in the police station. Delete also the sentence "Neechc walon ko pakadte hain - upar walon ko nahin (Sound only) Replaced with approved word Sound only".

Reduce the mishandling of Neetu by Prem.
Delete the words "Abc saule" as spoken by Rani. (Sound only).
Delete the underlined word from the following dialogue of Prem addressed to Rani: "Tumhe woh pyar aur maja denga". (Sound only).

Delete the words "Majai khud le gaya", as spoken by the cleaner of the lorry with reference to the driver taking away Neetu.

Delete the underlined word from the following dialogues of Punjabi couple: "Teri dikki to baad me kholoonga". (Sound only).
Reduce the scene of fire in the village.
Reduce to a suggestion only the shooting of a young boy, by deleting the portion where the bullet hits the boy, and also delete the word Bastard.
Reduce the drinking by Thakur and his wife, by deleting the beginning portion.
Reduce drastically the fight between Kunwar and Bhola, by deleting all hard hitting and gruesome shots.
Reduce the sword fight between Thakur and Raju to less than 90 ft. in length.
Reduce to less than 90 ft. in length the fight between Raju and the man in the disguise of Diwanti.
Delete the shot showing the Police Officer hitting his own head As an expression of getting fed up.
Delete the words: "harramzade", "Saala", "Saali", etc, as used by Prem and Rani in an abusive manner, anywhere in the film. (Sound only).
Delete the suggestive dialogue referring to "negative aur positive nahin multe to current nahin aate", as spoken by Rani.
Reduce drastically the shots of her scratching Raju and Nectu with her nails.
Reduce the fight sequence, including the gun fight to less than 90 ft. in length, by deleting the shots of hitting with jeep and other hard hitting and gruesome shots.
The total number of fights/violence sequence in the film should not be more than six, and the length of each such sequence should not exceed 90 ft. in length. LX Tijori room fight deleted.
XV Rajkumar hitting Raju with a bat deleted.
XVI Danco — whipping and Rani being shot.
IV Sound and suggestion of stone throwing deleted.
XV Sequence of electricity connection deleted.
Delete all nude shots superimposed on the Dollar.
Reduce to the barest minimum all firings - fight while trying to run away with the bag.
